intent: Three new concept alternatives replacing the rejected six-field Section 4 presentation

concepts.title: Study-stage gallery
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset: high fidelity flat front-facing browser screenshot of ONLY NSEDU homepage Section 4, a course eligibility checker. This is a fresh redesign, not an edit. Image 1 is ONLY a brand reference for palette and type; do not copy its tables, borders, form layout or content. Preserve wine #72243B, warm taupe #806C60, ivory #FFFAF8, pale greige #F1ECE8, dark plum #2A2024. Approximate DM Serif Display for editorial titles and Plus Jakarta Sans for controls. Render crisp accurate English typography, understated premium professional education product design. Wide landscape screenshot approximately 1800 x 820, no browser chrome, no page header or footer, not a full page or giant marketing hero. The user rejected six-field forms and generic white boxed layouts. New visual approach must feel crafted and contemporary while EASY for Indian students. One relevant question at a time; the only current question is study stage. No eligibility result before details. No invented admission guarantees, percentages, rankings, counts, speed estimates or AI accuracy. Exact three choices: "Studying in Class 12", "Class 12 completed", "College student / graduate". Choosing the third will ask completion status later. Selected choice is "Class 12 completed". Remaining admission year, course, board, subjects, correct mark basis and exam questions happen later and must NOT all appear now. Small help: "Diploma or another qualification? Choose here". Small explanatory line: "Requirements vary by course, institution and admission year." Small top or bottom label "NSEDU / ELIGIBILITY". No blue, purple, green, neon, glassmorphism, glossy gold, huge dark backdrops, excessive ornament, animated GIF marks, dense FAQ, accreditation or trust claims, stock student photography, floating random stickers or unreadable tiny text. Creative background is very light and deliberate, never impedes text. Main button not old gradient pill: modern flat wine and clearly labeled, 10px radius or clipped ticket edge, tasteful arrow.
Composition: Design an OPEN asymmetric editorial study-stage gallery, not a form inside one big bordered rectangle. Use ivory margins of ~70px. Left ~29% width contains small eyebrow "COURSE ELIGIBILITY", 44px beautiful three-line title "Your next step starts here.", sentence "Check course requirements, one simple question at a time.", and a tiny connected three-stop route with labels "Your studies", "Course details", "Requirements". Far behind only the left copy is a huge almost-invisible greige sweep like a folded page, stopping before text. Right ~66% contains 27px question "Where are you in your studies?" and muted hint "Choose the option that describes you today." Below are three horizontally arranged 230px by 240px choices with crafted editorial cropped-top corners, not generic rounded floating cards. Each has a beautiful modest tactile paper illustration of an academic object at the top: open exercise book and pencil for Class12studying; a course completion document and neatly closed book for Class12completed; a small folded graduation cap on two books for college. Each illustration is monochrome warm ivory/taupe with a small wine detail and naturally soft contact shadows, about70px tall, not cartoon emojis. Label below readable two lines, outlined radio at upper right. Middle card selected: wine thin border, pale warm rose fill, check indicator and small label "Selected". Unselected choices have greige fill and no thick border. Integrate the three into one continuous underlying pale curved paper band, beautiful subtle line around their bottoms rather than huge individual shadows. Below choices one aligned action row: underlined qualification help on the left, segmented flat wine "Continue" button on the right with a distinct square arrow end. Tiny bottom line "No sign-up to begin." and rule note. Lots of controlled space, compact content height. Charming material illustration and paper background, rigorous UI grid.

Composition: A totally DIFFERENT conversational UI on a warm ivory canvas with an asymmetric greige diagonal cut-paper background in the far lower left and a faint taupe curved route at far right. Do not use three horizontal choice cards. Upper section title on one line 42px serif "Let’s check your next step." with subtitle "A guided course check, built around your studies." Lower ~76%width contains a beautiful single conversation sheet, open white curved at only its top-left with no conventional rectangle border and barely perceptible shadow. A slim left margin rail with three small numbered stops labels "Studies", "Course", "Requirements", only first active. In the main conversation area a small circular wine/taupe spark-shaped NSEDU helper emblem beside a 24px conversational prompt "First, where are you in your studies?" and helper "We’ll ask only what is relevant to you." Underneath show three full-width horizontal selectable answer ROWS, 56px high, each has small outlined academic icon, exact choice label and radio at far right. Middle row selected, pale wine tint and fine wine left edge, all other rows white with simple baseline separators, not cards. Below answerrows help "Diploma or another qualification? Choose here". Footer of conversation sheet small "You can change your answer." left and modern flat wine button "Next question" right with arrow. At right outside the sheet, use a bespoke calm editorial illustration about200pxwide: a warm taupe thin path bends from a school book icon to a folded paper course slip and then an open campus arch, paper forms subtly extruded with very soft shadows. Three tiny annotationlabels "Your studies", "Course requirements", "Clear next steps". No precomputed result or status. Add small quiet "No sign-up to begin." Top right little "ONE QUESTION AT A TIME". This should feel like a helpful assessment tool rather than a chatbot marketing hero; no giant empty chat bubbles, fake chat history, heavy side information pane or unnecessary avatars.

Ivory outer background with a soft greige page-shaped horizontal sweep spanning the lower half, and two widely spaced ultra-light embossed concentric arcs cropped at far top-right. Heading top-left 40px serif "Know where you stand." and subtitle "Understand course requirements before you apply." Topright discreet "No sign-up to begin". Left narrow taupe panel 240pxwide containing small "ELIGIBILITY CHECK", 35px editorial "Your studies" and a bespoke small paper-cut academic book-and-certificate composition resting at the panel bottom, muted flat tactile illustration. The main tool right of that is an airy focus area: slim top journey nav "01 Studies" active wine underline, "02 Course details", "03 Requirements" thin separators; then 27px question "Where are you in your studies?". The ANSWERS are three very compact horizontal segmented selection buttons spanning one row, 64pxhigh and about300pxwide, with small academic outline icons, exactlabels (middle selected solid wine with white text and radio ring). These are buttons on one shared inset greige track, no separate tall cards. Below them qualification help link. Tool bottom on own narrow action rail: muted "Choose your study stage to continue." left and elegant wine "Continue" split button right, arrow area taupe with white arrow; selected study is explicitly visible already, so this hint is an instruction, not a result. Outside strip under bottomleft small rule note. Whole section about620pxhigh at1440width, compact spacing, clean120pxmax illustration. Light surprising paper geometry, cohesive sophisticated interface. No marks, course fields or result on this first step.
